title: Sci-fi corridor reveal
idea: a lone engineer walks down a dark spaceship corridor and a door opens onto a planet
style: hard sci-fi, cold palette with a single warm accent, volumetric haze, anamorphic flares
subject: a female engineer in a worn grey jumpsuit with a tool belt, short hair, carrying a handheld scanner
setting: a long, dim spaceship corridor with ribbed metal walls, thin haze in the air
light: cold blue strip lights along the floor as key, a warm orange glow leaking from the door at the end

beats.action: she walks away from the camera down the corridor, boots echoing, scanner light sweeping the walls
beats.camera: following shot from behind at shoulder height

beats.action: the door at the end slides open with a hiss and warm light floods the corridor
beats.camera: continue following, the warm light growing

beats.action: she stops in the doorway; beyond it a vast orange planet fills the sky
beats.camera: slow push past her shoulder towards the view

beats.action: she lowers the scanner and stares; dust drifts in the light
beats.camera: hold, framing her silhouette against the planet

physics: haze swirls as she passes; the door moves on a mechanical track at constant speed; dust catches the light and drifts slowly; her boots land with weight

sound.fx: boots on metal, the door hiss, a soft rising tone as the light floods in

notes: Light change is the beat: the warm door light is the only event the model needs to get right.
